newsitem.title: EGYPT: Islamic militants kill two police in south Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Islamic militants kill two police in south Egypt.

text.p: Suspected Moslem militants shot dead two police guards and wounded another when they opened fire on a police checkpoint in southern Egypt, security sources said on Saturday.
They said the incident took place late on Friday in Sahel Selim village in Assiut province, about 355 km (220 miles) south of Cairo.
Police in Assiut believe the gunmen were members of the militant al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which has targeted policemen as part of its anti-government campaign.
More than 1,000 people have died in political violence in Egypt since militants began a campaign in 1992 to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state.
